control_flow.shape: guarded forwarder. No switch, no jump table, no loop, no backward branch. Twelve conditional branches, all short forward jumps, and three internal forward jumps.

control_flow.early_exits: seven distinct exit edges, all converging on the single epilogue at 0x004388a2
control_flow.branch_polarity: Five guards exit on a FALSE-like condition (the two null checks, the zero byte, the bit-7 SET, and the two 0x004a7e60/other-+0x3e0 nulls). The bit-11 test has the opposite shape: JZ on the CLEAR case jumps to 0x0043888a, which is the code that DOES the work, so bit 11 SET is the conditional case. The x87 block inverts once more: JP skips, so the fallthrough is the equality edge, meaning the final forward runs only when self+0x1c0 is exactly 0.
control_flow.x87_note: FLDZ / FILD / FUCOMIP ST0,ST1 / FSTP / LAAH / TEST AH,0x44 / JP is a comparison against zero lifted into the x87 unit. FUCOMIP compares ST0 (0.0) with ST1 (the integer as a float) and sets ZF on equality and PF on unordered. Because no NaN can arise from FILD of a 32-bit integer, PF is always 0 here, so JP is never taken and only the equality edge falls through. The reconstruction keeps the integer comparison rather than the x87 sequence, which is semantically identical for a 32-bit integer input.

semantic_contract: Invariants, in the order the body establishes them. (1) 0x004388b0(self, other) runs unconditionally, before any guard. (2) If self->dword[0x28] is null the function returns. (3) If the byte at self->dword[0x28]+0x4f is zero the function returns. (4) If bit 7 of other->dword[0xdc8] is set the function returns. (5) If self->dword[0x3e0] is non-null then 0x004388b0(self->dword[0x3e0], other->dword[0x3e0]) runs if and only if other->dword[0x3e0] is non-null; a null other->dword[0x3e0] returns. (6) Otherwise, if other->dword[0x3e0] is null the function returns. (7) Otherwise, if 0x004a7e60(self) is false the function returns. (8) Otherwise, when bit 11 of self->dword[0xdc8] is clear, 0x004388b0(self, other->dword[0x3e0]) runs. (9) When bit 11 is set, the same call runs only if the dword at self+0x1c0 is zero, as tested by an x87 FUCOMIP against 0.0. The function writes nothing to either receiver, allocates nothing and calls no free; every effect is delegated to 0x004388b0, 0x004adc40, 0x004a7e60 and 0x0044f220. The dword at +0xdc8 is a 60-bit attribute field: 0x00435a10 writes bits 0..0x3B at +0xdc8 + (bit>>5)*4, which is the same arithmetic this function inlines twice. On a deterministic 0x004a7e60 the bit-11 sub-branch is reachable only when that predicate was already non-zero in AL, so the helper runs on both sub-paths in that case; the reconstruction nevertheless keeps the second read, because the FUCOMIP tests the full dword while the first test only examined AL.
classification_rationale: The full 128-instruction body was read directly: both +0x3e0 field accesses, both flag-bit tests including their inlined lowering and out-of-range defaults, the 0x004a7e60 and 0x0044f220 gates, the cdecl-cleanup boundary of 0x004a7e60, the x87 zero test and every one of the twelve branch polarities. The 60-bit width and the bit indexing are independently corroborated by the writer 0x00435a10, and 21 call sites plus a caller-side +0x3e0 read corroborate the field usage. Two material elements stay bounded. First, the owning class: Editors::EditorRigblock is a well-supported candidate resting on three independent observations, but no vtable was resolved and the binary has no RTTI, so it is not an established identity. Second, the role of 0x004388b0: its body is fully read, but release versus detach versus deferred-delete cannot be separated statically, so it stays an opaque port. A third, smaller bound: attribute bit 11 has no SDK enumerator, so no name is asserted for it. STRONG_SEMANTIC is withheld for those reasons and not for the body, which is complete; STRUCTURAL_ONLY would understate the evidence, since the behavioural contract is established rather than merely the layout.
semantic_findings: The function is a guarded forwarder. Five of its six callee invocations funnel into the single dominant callee 0x004388b0, and the entire 424-byte body exists to decide which receiver/candidate pair that callee sees.

The first 0x004388b0 call at 0x00438710 is unconditional. That is a direct instruction reading, not a decompiler artefact: 0x0043870c PUSH EAX and 0x00438710 CALL precede the first guard at 0x00438718.

The +0xdc8 field is a 60-bit attribute bitfield, proven by 0x00435a10's `bit < 0x3c` bound and its `(bit>>5)*4` dword indexing, which is the same arithmetic inlined twice here. The two JNC out-of-range edges in this body are therefore statically dead, and the decompiler's two 'Removing unreachable block' warnings name exactly those addresses.

The +0x28 sub-object and its +0x4f byte act as a master enable for the whole rigblock. The same guard triple appears verbatim in 0x00435a10, 0x0043e7e0, 0x0043eb50, 0x00449420 and 0x00448e90, so it is a shared type invariant rather than a local guard.
Bit 7 of the other object suppresses the whole cascade. SDK candidate name kEditorRigblockModelIsVertebra.

Bit 11 of the self object inverts the shape of the test: JZ on the CLEAR case jumps to the code that does the work, so bit 11 SET is the conditional case and it is gated on self+0x1c0 being exactly zero.

The bit-11 branch re-reads self+0x1c0 through 0x0044f220 even though 0x004a7e60(self) was already required non-zero a few instructions earlier. On a deterministic 0x004a7e60 that makes the sub-branch's condition equivalent to the predicate already checked; the reconstruction keeps the re-read because the FUCOMIP tests the full dword whereas the first test examined only AL.

The x87 sequence is a zero comparison, not a load-and-test. FLDZ pushes 0.0, FILD pushes the integer, FUCOMIP ST0,ST1 compares 0.0 against it, LAHF then TEST AH,0x44 selects ZF and PF, and JP skips on unordered. Since FILD of a 32-bit integer can never produce a NaN, PF is always 0 and only the equality edge falls through.
Neither receiver is written. Every one of the twelve exits reaches the same three-instruction epilogue, so the function is a pure forwarder with no state of its own.

0x00437b00 performs its own self-equality guard at 0x00437df6 before calling, which suggests self and other can be the same object; this function has no such guard and would then hand an object to itself.
unresolved_questions: Is the receiver really Editors::EditorRigblock? Three independent observations support it -- the 0x3c-bit attribute field, the 0xe08 'Editor' allocation with bit 0x14 set, and the shared +0x28 / +0x4f / +0x3e0 guard triple -- but no vtable was resolved and the binary has no RTTI, so this stays a candidate.
What is the role of 0x004388b0? Its body is fully read, but release, detach and deferred-delete cannot be separated statically. It remains an opaque port in the reconstruction.
What is 0x004a7e60 deciding? It is a two-level byte predicate with an unknown name, and its result gates the entire second half of this function.
What does the dword at +0x1c0 mean, and why does a zero there permit the cascade? The field is named only as an offset.
What is attribute bit 11? The SDK enum has no enumerator at 0x0B and duplicates 0x0A, so no name is asserted.
What is the +0x3e0 sub-object? It is a pointer to something with its own +0xdc8 attribute field, since 0x00435a10 applies the same bit writes to it. No type is established for it.
Are self and other guaranteed distinct? 0x00437b00's own guard suggests not, and this function has none.

Only three of the twenty-one call sites were disassembled window-by-window in this batch; the remaining eighteen receiver provenances were taken from the briefing's call graph and were not independently re-verified at the instruction level.

Unresolved callees are declared as opaque ports and given no fabricated bodies.
preserved_semantics: the +0x28 null guard and the +0x4f zero guard, in that order
bit 7 of other suppresses everything, with the SAME polarity as the original (JNZ exits)
the self-+0x3e0-present case forwards the other object's +0x3e0 and returns, never falling through
the self-+0x3e0-absent case requires other-+0x3e0 non-null and 0x004a7e60 non-zero
bit 11 CLEAR is the unconditional path and bit 11 SET is the conditional one -- the inverse of the bit-7 test
the bit-11 sub-path re-reads +0x1c0 rather than reusing the predicate result
no receiver byte is written, no allocation, no free
the stack word is callee-cleaned (RET 0x4), modelled with __attribute__((thiscall))

the two statically dead JNC out-of-range bit-test edges, which the reconstruction replaces with a plain shift-and-test on a 32-bit word -- identical for indices 7 and 11, which are the only ones the original ever uses

the x87 FLDZ / FILD / FUCOMIP / LAHF / TEST AH,0x44 sequence, replaced by an integer comparison against 0, which is semantically identical for a 32-bit integer input and cannot differ on NaN because FILD of a 32-bit integer never produces one
